about_the_game:
In the year 2025, the world collapsed. Humanity was wiped out by a single person who changed everything. Lawless sheeps (minions) and mercenaries now dominate the ruins of what was once civilization. You are a survivor, a dissident, forced to endure amidst the chaos. To escape this regime, you must face everything and everyone, rescue other dissidents, and find your path in a world where rules no longer exist.

Rovolucion: The Sandwich Conspiracy is a satirical first-person shooter inspired by real events and absurd politics.
Battle hordes of brainwashed enemies, explore a twisted post-apocalyptic Ecuador, and collect the mysterious purple serum — humanity’s last hope to reverse the infection.

⚔️ Features

  • 🧠 Intense first-person combat against waves of corrupted “sheep.”

  • 🌆 A post-apocalyptic world filled with hidden references, humor, and local flavor.

  • 🧪 Collect purple serum to unlock progress and uncover the conspiracy.

  • 🎯 Simple, fast-paced FPS gameplay — easy to play, hard to survive.

  • 🎮 A unique mix of satire and action that doesn’t take itself too seriously.

Are you ready to give humanity one more chance?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 720p with medium settings, 30 FPS. SSD recommended for faster load times. Keyboard and mouse required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p with high settings, 60 FPS. SSD recommended.. Keyboard and mouse required

short_description: Robolucion: The Sandwich Conspiracy is a fast-paced first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic era, where mind-controlled “sheep” have taken over. Fight your way through hordes of brainwashed citizens, collect the mysterious purple serum, and uncover the truth behind the Sandwich Conspiracy.
